name: 蔡府伯
objective:
基本控制系統的動作方式、位置控制、比例控制、積分控制、微分控制、各種組合控制、氣壓控制裝置、電動及電子控制裝置、液壓控制裝置、空調設備上的各種控制包括溫度、壓力、風量、濕度等之控制。
To provide students with the concepts of control actions: two position control, proportional control, floating control, integral control, derivative control; to familiarize students with pneumatic control devices, fluid control devices, damper & valves, elementary control systems on HVAC & R systems, include: temperature control, humidity control, static pressure control, flow control and so on.
schedule:
1	   Introduction to Control Systems
2-4	   Mathematical Modeling of Control Systems
5-7	   Mathematical Modeling of Mechanical Systems and Electrical Systems
8	   期中考
9-11    Transient and Steady-State Response Analyses
12-14  Control Systems Analysis and Design by the Root-Locus Method
15-17  PID Controllers and Modified PID Controllers
18	   期末報告
scorePolicy:
作業及課堂表現: 30%
期中考 30%
期末報告 40%
materials:
Modern Control Engineering
Fifth Edition
Katsuhiko Ogata
consultation: 每週二下午綜合科館 610-1 諮詢
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
